description.blurb: S/2016 J 3 is a small outer natural satellite of Jupiter discovered in 2016 but only announced and confirmed in early 2023.
description.more: S/2016 J 3 is part of the Carme group, a tight cluster of retrograde irregular moons of Jupiter that follow similar orbits to Carme at semi-major axes between 22–24 million km (14–15 million mi), orbital eccentricities between 0.2–0.3, and inclinations between 163–166°. It has a diameter of about 2 km (1.2 mi) for an absolute magnitude of 16.7.
